document_role: Documentary specification for the future three-model benchmark, ranking, baseline and inference; not executed results.
nonexecutable_reason: The final trio, run configurations, cohorts, seed lists, inference families and test/update policies remain incomplete.

source_design.role: Current chapter4 documentary design including the guide-aligned proposal; experimental configuration remains unfrozen.

problem_contract.missingness: strict exclusion, no imputation, preserve calendar positions

model_selection.retained_documentary_profiles_role: LSTM/TCN/encoder fields refer to previously recovered literature profiles, not the guide-aligned project proposal.

comparable_population.matched_origin_and_metric_policy: Compare the same eligible dates, targets, coverage and registered seed repetitions within each configuration.
comparable_population.prediction_failures: Follow the registered incident/coverage rule; do not silently discard difficult dates or unfavorable seeds.
comparable_population.different_n: Different prediction targets; do not pool their raw RMSE into one winner.
comparable_population.global_D_rule_requirement: If one global baseline is wanted, register a development-only D-selection rule and comparable population before test. Otherwise retain baseline by configuration.
comparable_population.configuration_vs_evaluation_identity: The model-task/protocol configuration is stable across phases; each evaluation records its own phase/period/cohort/mask. A changed evaluation year does not select another baseline.

ranking.run_score: For each model/configuration/seed, first pool its eligible out-of-training date predictions and compute sqrt(mean squared error).
ranking.primary_model_score: Arithmetic mean across the registered seeds of those per-run RMSE values.
not_equivalent_to: RMSE pooled over seed x date error rows
RMSE of predictions averaged across seeds
average of unit-origin daily RMSE values
ranking.dispersion: Sample standard deviation with ddof1 across the same per-run metric values.
ranking.tie_warning: A small or nonsignificant difference and overlapping marginal intervals do not establish equivalence.
ranking.cost_and_parameter_frontiers: Descriptive error-time and error-parameter or explicitly multidimensional fronts, with uncertainty and measurement conditions; they do not change the primary ranking after test.

baseline_selection.selection_data_period: Development selection in2024 under the registered chapter4 procedure; temporally nested selection is required for any claimed independent outer2024 assessment.
baseline_selection.selection_statistic: Lowest development mean_seed_rmse_of_pooled_date_predictions within a comparable configuration, with preregistered tie handling.
baseline_selection.scope: One development-selected baseline per (n,D,h,data/protocol version), unless a global D-selection rule is closed in development. Evaluation phase/year/cohort does not reopen that choice.
baseline_selection.test_ranking_role: Descriptive; does not reopen development selection or silently replace the operational baseline.
baseline_selection.test_extreme_selection_inference: Empirical best/worst identities are data-dependent. Inferential claims require a procedure treating that selection, not a comparison falsely presented as fixed a priori.

descriptive_differences.model_metric_summary: Mean of the same per-run metric values under the registered seed population.
descriptive_differences.default_percent_aggregation: Ratio of per-run mean metrics, not mean of per-seed percentage ratios.
descriptive_differences.sign: Positive means less error than the identified reference; negative means greater error.
descriptive_differences.best_and_worst_reference_ids: Identify extrema separately for RMSE and MAE within the same comparable table; do not assume the identities coincide.
reference_roles_to_distinguish: descriptive test-best for the named metric
descriptive test-worst for the named metric
descriptive_differences.paired_uncertainty: Preserve matched models/seeds/dates and recompute the registered functional, including reference denominator, under the selected inference unit.

effect_size.difference_orientation: d_s = metric_A,s - metric_B,s; negative favors A for error metrics.
effect_size.zero_paired_sd_case: Undefined dz; retain the case and report the raw difference and uncertainty.
effect_size.not_default: Cliff delta computed over all marginal A x B comparisons is not an automatic replacement for a matched-pair effect.
effect_size.scope: Effects among training seeds are conditional on the calendar and procedure; temporal effects require their own justified dependence-aware construction.

inference_pending.pairing_rule: Same registered configuration, cohort and repetition or temporal blocks; do not treat all dates x seeds x models as independent observations.
inference_pending.comparison_family_scope: Declare which model/reference pairs, metrics, n, D, horizons and period-specific claims belong to each family before evaluating.
inference_pending.report: Difference and effect, CI95 with construction/unit/scope, statistic, raw and adjusted numeric p-values, reference distribution and approximation status.

temporal_DM_pending.test_name: Diebold-Mariano with an explicitly justified Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold small-sample correction
temporal_DM_pending.loss_function_for_primary_RMSE_context: Squared forecast error in original target units.
temporal_DM_pending.date_loss_difference: d_t = squared_error_A,t - squared_error_B,t under a registered forecast/seed rule.
temporal_DM_pending.null: Expected date-level squared-loss difference equals zero.
temporal_DM_pending.relationship_to_ranking: This is a date-level squared-loss estimand. It is not automatically a test of the chapter5 mean-over-seed RMSE ranking statistic.
temporal_DM_pending.target_overlap_warning: Consecutive sigma7 labels share six returns; h=1 does not imply independent date losses.
temporal_DM_pending.no_automatic_h_minus_one_bandwidth: Do not set bandwidth zero solely because actual h=1. Serial dependence and target overlap require justification.
temporal_DM_pending.HLN_correction_status: A small-sample approximation, not an exact finite-sample p-value or repair for arbitrary nonstationarity/dependence.
temporal_DM_pending.no_automatic_n_minus_one_bandwidth: Six shared returns do not impose an upper bound of six on serial dependence or HAC bandwidth.
temporal_DM_pending.standard_HLN_factor: sqrt((T + 1 - 2*h + h*(h-1)/T)/T) under its applicable assumptions; real h=1 gives sqrt((T-1)/T), not a general calibration for extra dependence.
temporal_DM_pending.zero_or_invalid_long_run_variance: Record statistic as undefined with its cause; do not manufacture a favorable p-value.

residual_diagnostics_pending.interpretation: Residual dependence identifies model limitations or dependence under assumptions; BDS rejection is not exclusive proof of exploitable nonlinearity, and no diagnostic guarantees predictive profit.

practical_and_advanced_thresholds.accepted_reference: Persistence only, on the same eligible dates.
practical_and_advanced_thresholds.practical_vs_zero_null: Detecting a difference from zero is distinct from demonstrating gain above the practical boundary.
practical_and_advanced_thresholds.variance_identity: Var(A-B) = Var(A) + Var(B) - 2 Cov(A,B) under the registered pairing/estimand.

future_advanced_comparison.conditional_new_evaluation_requirement: If the advanced model/design is adapted after inspecting benchmark test results, independent confirmation requires a previously unused evaluation period/population and a frozen procedure; the same inspected test cannot be relabelled untouched.
future_advanced_comparison.unassigned_period_source: 2026-09-01 through2026-10-30 remains unassigned; future evaluation eligibility and acquisition are separate decisions.
future_advanced_comparison.comparison_population_and_information_re: Compare the fixed baseline and advanced procedure on the same newly eligible dates, target, data and information rules; quantify uncertainty for that comparison.

benchmark_table.format: Long format: one metric summary per model/configuration/period and declared seed population; header only.

contrasts_table.format: One declared contrast/estimand/inference unit per row; header only.

general_tests_pending.diagnostic_role: Shapiro-Wilk and Q-Q assess paired-difference assumptions; they are not an automatic post-observation selector of the smallest p-value or a license to change estimands.
general_tests_pending.Nemenyi_control: Nemenyi already controls its comparison family; do not stack another adjustment as if it were the same correction without a stated additional purpose.

equivalence.TOST_interpretation: For unadjusted alpha0.05 under an applicable TOST/CI method, both one-sided tests must reject and the corresponding90percent decision CI must lie wholly within the prespecified band. This differs from the95percent reporting CI.

before_benchmark_test_close: Substantiate exactly three final DL architectures and complete the chapter4 implementation/run configuration.
Register comparable cohorts, seed sets and handling of failed runs; keep primary and sensitivity targets separate.
Close development ranking/D/tie rules and operational baseline identities, then freeze before test.
Register contrast estimands, seed/date uncertainty methods, multiplicity, DM forecast/seed treatment and HAC/HLN settings.
Record practical/advanced/equivalence margins only for their justified reference and claim; do not transplant the persistence criterion.
Freeze the test/update/reporting procedure and maintain the conditional fresh-evaluation requirement for later adaptive advanced designs.
plan_stage_order: Close documentary trio, pipeline, cohorts, seed/run definitions and inference/reporting rules before the corresponding development runs.
Run development selection under the registered chapter4 design; compute selection scores and choose baseline identities only from those results.
Freeze the selected baseline procedure, D/tie decisions and evaluation/reporting plan before benchmark test.
Evaluate the fixed procedures in test and report descriptive rankings without reopening selection.
